A complete dental programme built for clinic supply and distributor catalogues alike: adult and paediatric extracting forceps across the American and English patterns, Cryer and Coupland root elevators, Gracey and universal curettes, sickle and periodontal scalers, mouth mirrors, explorers, probes, and perforated and rim-lock impression trays.

All 1,559 references below carry their Opix catalogue number and working length. Prices are quoted, never published — send an inquiry and our team returns a formal FOB or CIF quotation, with MOQ and lead time, within one working day.
